title: Act: Seed worlds GitOps tree and layout validator
summary: Create ROUND-0000001 seed YAML, root env example, README map, ValidateLayout.
description:
Context: Backend module exists after ACT-BE; tip still lacks GitOps YAML.
Desired behavior: Seed world.yaml, current-release.yaml, round.yaml, enrich .env.example, README module map, and layout.go ValidateLayout over fs.FS.
Expected result: Required paths and ROUND-0000001 seed fields match REQ-GITOPS; validator checks those paths.
Why: Implements REQ-GITOPS product code only.
acceptance_criteria: Given Act complete, when reading round.yaml, then id ROUND-0000001, number 1, status OPEN, duration_hours 24, max_contributions_per_player 5, base_release 1.0.0.
Given ValidateLayout, when required paths exist in an FS, then it returns nil.
Given root .env.example and README, when opened, then module paths and example env keys are documented.

preserve: game content YAML remains separate from GitOps YAML

technical_constraints: Depends on go.mod from ACT-BE for layout.go package main
definition_of_done: No test files added by this Act

steps.action: Extend root .env.example so it documents VITE_API_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8080, VITE_APP_NAME=StoryForge, BACKEND_CONFIG=config.example.yaml, WORKER_CONFIG=worker.config.example.yaml. No real secrets.
steps.expected: Root example env points at module configs.

steps.action: Replace documentation-only greeting with StoryForge bootstrap README that keeps a one-line Worldseed identity note and maps root-level modules: frontend (package.json/Vite), backend+worker (go.mod), game (runtime.ts + world-content.yaml), GitOps (world.yaml/round.yaml).
steps.code:
before: hello Worldseed
after:
# StoryForge

Worldseed monorepo bootstrap for StoryForge (Phase-1 root layout).

## Modules (repo root)
- Frontend — React + TypeScript + Vite (`package.json`, `main.tsx`)
- Backend — Go + Chi (`go.mod`, `main.go`, `router.go`)
- Game — runtime in `runtime.ts`, content in `world-content.yaml`
- Worker — local AI development worker (`worker.go`, `worker_config.go`)
- GitOps — `world.yaml`, `current-release.yaml`, `round.yaml`

See `.env.example` and `*.example.yaml`.
steps.expected: README documents StoryForge module layout while retaining Worldseed identity context.

steps.action: Create RequiredPaths slice listing world.yaml, current-release.yaml, round.yaml. Export ValidateLayout(fsys fs.FS) error that returns fmt.Errorf("missing required path: %s", path) for the first path where fs.Stat fails, else nil. Package main.
steps.expected: ValidateLayout reports missing required GitOps paths via fs.FS.
